title: Multimedia Producer
summary: Freelance advertisements, logos, and event compilations for private clients and mid-sized companies.

cover.alt: Aerial view of a roof deck with the T-10 Construction logo overlaid

sections.heading: Role
paragraphs: Worked with private clients and mid-sized companies (i.e. construction, photography), creating advertisements, logos, and compilations of corporate events. Applied understanding of professional-grade music production, video editing, photo manipulation, and animation software to tailor final products to client specifications.
